brief_favorable_conditions: Cold, well-oxygenated mountain streams (12–17 °C), continuous cloudy canopy and stable daily temperatures.
why_these_variables: Air temperature as a stream-temperature proxy, cloudiness and thermal stability (the brief links thermal swings to chytrid outbreaks). Water temperature and oxygen are not available.
absolute_value_caution: Montane species: the NASA grid cell is a regional average and cannot resolve mountain-stream microclimates. Prefer the change versus normal over absolute values.

variables.label: Mean air temperature
variables.aggregation: Day-weighted annual mean of monthly means

variables.label: Monthly temperature range
variables.aggregation: Annual mean of (monthly maximum − monthly minimum)
